desc: Online, everyone sees everyone's cards: the host picks the adventure (TTYD_TOGETHER_PICK); the guest (seat 2) opens its card with its Start and moves right once; the host's screen draws the same card at 2P's place (left), mirrored from the guest's player message. Then the host opens its Start menu: the guest's screen has no such menu, so its place shows a lasting "Paused by Test Host" card until the host closes it (the guest's own card closes), and the guest's Start there says so. The two games' scripts meet by wait_peer (the host waits for the guest's card to open and close, the guest for the host's pause), so launches staggered under load don't matter. Shots: guest_card (guest), host_sees_guest (host), paused_by_host (guest), host_menu (host). Nothing of the port's crosses another box or the Start menu's help box ($TTYD_UI_OVERLAP)

log_must: \[playermenu\] seat 2's card \(player 2's game\) is open here too
\[playermenu\] player 2: Start while the host's Start menu is up
